text.description_html:
TC831 Mini Roto Global Series Hydraulic Door Closer

** Item Discontinued



The Global TC831 Series is a great alternative for use on interior and light weight exterior door applications. Its mini size makes it very versatile, and allows you to mount it in places that most door closers won't even begin to fit.

Budget cost, high quality hydraulic closer. Ideal for storm doors and screen doors up to 35 lbs.

Can be used for specialty applications. Reversible for left and right hand doors. Adjustable closing speed for better door control.

Global TC831 Specifications:

  • Maximum Door Size: 36" Interior Door/ 30" Exterior Door
  • Maximum Door Weight: 35 lbs
  • Spring Tension: Size #1
  • Height / Length: 3-3/4" tip to tip
  • Cylinder Diameter / Width: 2"
  • Arm Fully Extended: 7-1/2"
  • Mount bracket outside measurement: 2-1/4" x 1-1/4"
  • Adjustable tension allows you to regulate door closing speed
  • Non-Handed
  • Allows Door to Open Full 180 Degrees

Aluminum / Natural Metal Finish.



** Note: Item Discontinued
